claims.claim: Second-quarter revenues totaled $31.6 billion, an increase of 2.3% from the year-ago quarter.
Diluted EPS from continuing operations was $0.66, compared to $0.62 in the year-ago quarter.
Adjusted EPS was $0.65, compared to $0.54 in the year-ago quarter.
Adjusted operating income was $7.5 billion, compared to $6.5 billion in the year-ago quarter.
Adjusted EBITDA was $12.3 billion, up 5.2% year over year.
Free cash flow was $4.7 billion, compared to $4.4 billion in the year-ago quarter.
Advanced Connectivity service revenue grew 5.1% year over year.
Advanced Connectivity had 646,000 total consumer and business internet net adds, comprising 367,000 fiber and 279,000 fixed wireless.
The Advanced Connectivity segment reported operating income of $7.3 billion.
The Advanced Connectivity segment reported adjusted EBITDA of $12.0 billion.
claims.note: Basis error. The release reports Advanced Connectivity segment EBITDA of $12.0 billion (operating income of $7.3B plus D&A of $4.7B). 'Adjusted EBITDA' is a distinct consolidated measure ($12.3 billion, including $334 million of adjustments); the release does not report an adjusted EBITDA figure at the segment level.

claims.claim: Legacy segment revenues declined 25.9% year over year.
The Legacy segment reported operating income of $523 million.
The Legacy segment reported adjusted EBITDA of $523 million.
claims.note: Basis error. The release reports Legacy segment EBITDA of $523 million, not adjusted EBITDA; segment-level EBITDA is defined as operating income before D&A and carries no non-GAAP adjustments.

claims.claim: Latin America segment revenues increased 16.1% year over year.
The Latin America segment reported adjusted EBITDA of $227 million.
claims.note: Basis error. The release reports Latin America segment EBITDA of $227 million, not adjusted EBITDA.

claims.claim: For 2026-2028, the Company expects annual capital investment in the $23 billion to $24 billion range.
The Company projects free cash flow of $18 billion+ in 2026, $19 billion+ in 2027, and $21 billion+ in 2028.
The Company's long-term outlook for 2026-2028 includes annual service revenue growth in the low-single-digit range.
The Company is accelerating the pace of planned share repurchases in 2026 to approximately $10 billion.
Total debt was $144.0 billion at the end of the second quarter.
Net debt was $126.4 billion at the end of the second quarter.
The Company plans to return $45 billion+ to shareholders during 2026-2028 through dividends and share repurchases.
The Company aims to reach over 40 million total fiber locations by the end of 2026.
The Company expects legacy service revenue decline of 20%+ in 2026.
The Company expects its net debt-to-adjusted EBITDA ratio to reach a target in the 2.5x range within approximately three years following the closing of the EchoStar transaction.
